description_excerpt: The Costing Engineer in Material Costing Intelligence (MCI) is part of the Product Supply Enablement (PSE) function at VF Corporation. Based in Vietnam, this role is responsible for engineering product cost from a construction and manufacturing perspective, while supporting costing framework governance, costing data quality and vendor negotiations. The role partners closely with sourcing teams, product development teams, suppliers, and factory costing counterparts to strengthen pre-costing, improve cost transparency and predictability and deliver cost-saving initiatives.
